scope: All legal decision/planned execution points in 2024-25, including prior warmup signal at first training execution. Equal-weight unit-event labels, not accounts or annualized returns. Next-bar limit uses downward .01 tick and public resolve_fill; 65 completed held bars then next-bar market open with .1% each side. Unmature labels excluded, never filled from 2026. Coarse year/slot and preset previous ATR/Close 1% layers are descriptive controls, reused and overlapping; no independence, causality or new signal gate. No test access, account replay, new experiment or parameter search.
